quirks.detail: Write the generated text into the textarea where it exists. It renders in Seek's own UI, which is what a recruiter reads first. Only fall back to a file upload when no textarea is present.
quirks.summary: The cover letter is an editable textarea, not a second upload.

quirks.detail: The flow's step loop is what walks them; the adapter only describes the step it is on. A one-step assumption would miss every screening question.
quirks.summary: Screening questions sit on their own step, after the documents step.

quirks.detail: That single slot is exactly why combined.pdf is built.
quirks.summary: Usually one file slot, because the cover letter is inline.

quirks.detail: detect_redirect fires when the host leaves Seek. That path is the majority of real volume, not an edge case.
quirks.summary: Most Seek applications forward into an employer ATS.
